topic: Phone won't charge: charging port or battery?
record_type: new tips page (Sam asked for it Nov 25; goes live only on his publish yes)
uniqueness: A decision page, not another troubleshooting list. /tips/phone-charges-slowly covers the whole charging path and slow charging; /tips/iphone-charging-cable-loose-angle covers fit, lint and safe cleaning. This page is the split between the two repairs: the charging-sign pattern, the half-hour Apple sequence, four deciding tests (wireless pad, computer connection, off the charger, the battery's own report) and a result matrix.
bench_point: None added. No invented bench stories, stats or prices. Prices only in the generated price strip, from pricing-data.json.
scope: Hardware triage (charging port, battery, charge circuit). Counts toward the 80% hardware mix.
